main_measure.name: mean signed excess 20-bar return over cases with abs(forecast) >= 2 (before costs)
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 over at least 30 cases confirms (with supporting check > 0); t <= -2 over at least 30 cases rejects

supporting_check.name: mean signed excess return, larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: The main-measure t is 2 or more over at least 30 cases and the supporting check difference is above 0.
reading: The situation is taken as a non-zero raw term (the graded size), its side as the sign of the raw term, compared with the sign of a non-zero forecast; the median split puts cases with abs(forecast) above the median in the larger half and the rest in the smaller half; the drift is each coin's mean 20-bar return on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; fewer than 30 cases is reported as not observable.
